fact: The 2022-23 Mozambique Demographic and Health Survey, implemented by INE, published its final report in May 2024, with fieldwork from July 2022 to March 2023 and a sample of 14,250 households drawn from the 2017 census enumeration areas.
title: Mozambique Demographic and Health Survey 2022-23 Final Report
publisher: National Statistics Institute / The DHS Program
